about.heading: About Me
about.p1: I'm a full-stack software developer currently working at SAMLA, MedicFlow, and Blue Bird Consulting, where I bridge technical expertise with business strategy. I specialize in building scalable web applications using React.js, Next.js, and SQL that solve real business challenges through robust backend architecture and intuitive frontend design.
about.p2: My portfolio showcases projects across healthcare, legal, and insurance industries where I've delivered measurable impact. From developing HIPAA-compliant AI-powered medical applications to building law firm websites with integrated booking systems, I focus on translating business requirements into production-ready applications that provide genuine value to users and clients.

hobbies.heading: Hobbies
hobbies.text: Away from the keyboard, I'm usually making coffee: I like experimenting with brew methods and recipes, and I'm partial to lattes and pour-overs. I also collect vinyl, mostly rock and pop, with <artists>Clairo, The Midnight, Oasis, Fleetwood Mac, Coldplay and Sabrina Carpenter</artists> in heavy rotation. At home, I share the couch with Toby and Milo, my two golden doodles.
